description: This file defines the TypesNode class within the Twig templating engine, representing a node related to types in the abstract syntax tree constructed during template compilation.

classes.name: TypesNode
classes.description: A node class representing types within Twig's syntax tree, extending the base Node class and intended for use within the Twig environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TypesNode with a specified mapping of types and source code line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Defines how the node should be compiled, but intentionally left empty, indicating this node does not produce direct output.
